designationHistory.indexText: Congress established Yukon Delta National Wildlife Refuge in the Alaska National Interest Lands Conservation Act, signed by President Jimmy Carter on December 2, 1980, combining the Clarence Rhode, Hazen Bay and Nunivak refuges.

review.note: Year confirmed; exact date and statute added. Predecessors: Nunivak Island Reservation (1929), Hazen Bay (1937), Kuskokwim/Clarence Rhode range (1960-61). Separately, Theodore Roosevelt created a Yukon Delta Reservation by EO 1041 on Feb. 27, 1909, revoked in 1922; it is not a continuous predecessor but is worth a note on the page.

designationHistory.indexOriginal: Yukon Delta National Wildlife Refuge was established in 1980 to protect the wildlife and diverse habitats nestled on the delta between the mighty Yukon and Kuskokwim rivers of Alaska.
